- [RLOW.8.3.5] `s.dwell` (only on `logical` bindings) →
  the monotonic clock's sample minus the fact's entry stamp
  ([LEXP.9.5.1]): a `CallExpr` of `FN_MONOTONIC_NS` minus an
  `entry_stamp` read (`proto/rete_expr.proto#Expr`) — a pure compile-time alias, not a
  series query (per [LSER.10.4]).
